summary: Designed client-only native-share delta: pure shareVideoFile helper with injectable canShare/share, success status retains File past download URL revoke, ReplayTransportBar Share on user gesture only, AbortError quiet, no server APIs/auto-share. Artifact: loop/architecture-native-share.md.
goal: After downloading climb replay video, allow sharing via Apple & Android native share sheets.

learnings.insight: Download object URL revoke (~1s) is independent of share retention: success status must carry a File that owns the bytes until Dismiss/new export/unmount. Do not share via the revoked blob URL.
learnings.action: On encode success: new File([blob], filename, { type: container MIME }); setStatus({ kind:'success', label, file }); clear file reference in dismissStatus/startExport/unmount only.

learnings.insight: canShare probe must be files-only; optional title/text belong on share() only. Assembled File.type must be container MIME (video/mp4|video/webm), not MediaRecorder codec string — WebM must not be forged as mp4.
learnings.action: Implement shareVideoFile.ts with injectable canShare/share; assert probe payload has only files; WebM fixture uses type video/webm in both gate and share.

learnings.insight: Share must be invoked only from ReplayTransportBar click — hook must not expose share() and onstop must never call navigator.share. AbortError maps to result.reason==='aborted' (non-error UI).
learnings.action: Unit-test shareVideoFile with fake reject AbortError vs NotAllowedError; success-transition test asserts share fake not called; reject source greps for navigator.share.

learnings.insight: Native-share delta adds zero product API surface and never POSTs video bytes; free-leaderboard trust boundary remains open and out of scope.
learnings.action: Confirm no new routes/env secrets; do not mark F-1 closed when reviewing this change.

learnings.insight: Native-share architecture maps all 10 AC-NS-* to contracts across 1 new module (shareVideoFile.ts), 2 amended modules (useReplayExport, ReplayTransportBar), 5 ADRs, and zero HTTP endpoints.
learnings.action: Implementer checklist in loop/architecture-native-share.md §14; nextStage implementer.

openQuestions: Share accessible name defaults to Share (product default) — implemented label may be Share video if space allows.

keyNormativeRules.api: navigator.share({ files }) + canShare({ files }) via shareVideoFile.ts
